mathematics.assertion_tested: Three exact rational energy/kinematic split controls and deterministic finite-dimensional l=1 Rayleigh-Ritz controls of the closed common-profile two-fluid n=1 TF state: relative positive gaps, total translation null direction, positive total internal modes, zero positive-total-mode integrated mass dipoles, and finite-k physical source strengths. Exact common-profile cancellation itself is proved analytically, not inferred from numerical controls.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact Q for three split controls; binary64 Gauss-Legendre quadrature and symmetric generalized eigenproblems for radial controls
mathematics.conventions: x=r/R in [0,1]; f=sin(pi x)/(pi x); angular Y_10 unit norm; frequency squared in GM/R^3; total Poisson exterior decays at infinity; TF fluid limit with baryon p_b=K_b rho_b^2 closure
inputs: Kd,Kb=(1,1),(1/3,7/2),(11,2/7), exact rational signed density and velocity controls
relative radial basis sizes N=6,10,14,18 and total N=6,10,14; u_j=x P_j^(0,3/2)(2x^2-1)
Gauss-Legendre quadrature orders 128 and comparison 192 at N=14
finite kR=0.01,0.03,0.1,0.3,1,3 for total l=1 internal modes
non_claims: No certified eigenvalue enclosures or global mode completeness from finite Ritz matrices
No baryon EOS or composition ratio derived from the particle action
No finite-GP convergence, surface-layer control, finite-temperature stability or production occupation
No universal source cancellation for unequal profiles or all shared states
No local occupied saturating dipole inventory, rational constitutive law or universal a0 or normalization
